title: Senior Director Data Engineering
description:
Senior Director, Data Engineering - Professional Services - Consulting (Brazil)

About phData

phData is an AI-forward engineering company focused on getting enterprise data and AI workloads in production for some of the largest and most well-known companies in the world.

We specialize in the most complex data, machine learning, and AI problems that only the best engineers can solve. From the top down, we’re built and run by hardcore data, ML, and AI engineers.

  • Founders and leadership teams wrote books on databases and built key open-source tools, including Kafka, Parquet, Hive, and more.
  • We are a partner to major cloud data platforms like Snowflake (6X POTY), AWS, Azure, GCP, Fivetran, dbt, OpenAI, Anthropic, and more.
  • We have nearly 700 employees operating across 3 continents, and we’re growing quickly.
  • We build AI and automation tools that no other consulting company has, enabling us to do more with smaller teams and without sacrificing quality.
  • We are not staff aug. We are a premium provider of data and AI services and our clients pay to work with the best teams.

Our Core Values

  • Grit. We make sacrifices and accomplish the mission no matter what, because greatness demands commitment.
  • Psychological Safety. We take risks, try new things, and have uncomfortable conversations without fear. We know that failure is the mother of success.
  • Curiosity. We seek genuine feedback and assume positive intent. We challenge assumptions, explore boldly, and never settle for “good enough” or “because we’ve always done it that way”.
  • Community. We do the work to help the team, not to collect personal recognition. No task is beneath us, and no ego is above the work. If something needs doing, we do it—whether or not anyone notices.

About the Role

This person will act as the technical leader for phData’s most strategic clients. This is among the most challenging, highest-profile, and highest-value roles in all of phData.

Why is this one of the most challenging? This person must have a versatile arsenal of skills, technical knowledge, and communication styles. It’s more than saying the right thing. The Technical Account Lead must also be able to write code, stay up to date with the latest developments in technology, and lead and motivate a team to respond to the challenges and high expectations of our clients.

If our clients could solve these problems themselves, they would. Instead, they hire phData. We see ourselves as the client’s special forces and do what it takes to complete the mission. The Technical Account Lead doesn’t just get into the weeds—they study the entire root system.

This person needs to proactively give feedback internally and externally. They need to make sure we have the right people and the best teams. They will interface at the executive level, tackling uncomfortable conversations head-on and through a lens of respect, ownership, and integrity.

Our ultimate goal is to make our clients say “wow”. The ultimate measure of success for a Technical Account Lead is when a client chooses to extend projects with us and expand into new projects and workloads with us. The Technical Account Lead is personally accountable for converting highly strategic first-time engagements into multi-year partnerships, and growing strategic clients into $10M+ in annual value.

About You

  • You’ve been the person others relied on to make the hard technical calls and guide execution at scale.
  • You can sit across from a Fortune 500 CTO, ask door-opening questions, and confidently recommend a roadmap that changes how they think about data or AI.
  • You are client-obsessed. You know the history, business context, and org structure of whoever you work with.
  • You know greatness doesn’t come from working 9 to 5.
  • You know that giving and receiving feedback, internally and externally, is your fastest path to excellence and meaningful relationships.
  • You are a builder. You aren’t looking for a company that has it all figured out already. You want to have a voice in building something great.
  • You thrive on and grow through change.
  • You want to work alongside the brightest minds in data and AI.

Job Requirements

  • Act as the executive-level technical leader for a set of strategic clients, operating like the account’s CTO: owning technology direction, technical stakeholder relationships, and strategic alignment.
  • Build trusted relationships with technical and business stakeholders through 1:1s, on-site visits, and active engagement across initiatives.
  • Lead key client events (e.g., QBRs, Innovation Days, workshops) and contribute content that connects strategic goals with technical execution.
  • Develop and maintain a technology strategy and roadmap tailored to the client’s goals, providing hands-on architectural guidance when needed.
  • Partner closely with the account team to drive growth by collaborating on strategy and opportunity creation.
  • Write and guide scopes, proposals, and pricing estimates. Enable other leaders to do the same using phData’s processes and templates.
  • Create and present clear deliverables (e.g. architecture diagrams, enablement docs, POVs) that drive alignment from execs to practitioners.
  • Help the client operationalize data and AI projects—ensuring ideas move from prototype to production with measurable business impact.
  • Act as the ultimate owner of technical success for the client:
  • Resolve technical and strategic escalations across delivery and act as a point of accountability for both phData and the client
  • Hold delivery quality to a high standard, onboard new team members effectively, and continuously identify areas for improvement
  • Track and report KPIs that demonstrate client success and business value; use data to inform strategy and improve delivery
  • Meet minimum billable utilization requirements within book of business
  • Educate internal teams on successful delivery patterns and contribute to phData’s internal playbooks, QBR content, and sales collaboration.
  • Cultivate and manage relationships with key technology partners.
  • BA/BS in computer science, engineering, business, operations, or related fields preferred.
  • Must have demonstrated experience leading highly technical engineering teams or serving as the chief architect in a complex, hands-on technical environment.
  • Travel up to 35% (client-dependent).

title: Senior React Engineer
description:
Senior React Engineer

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior React Engineer to focus on building modern, scalable, and high-performance web applications. This role emphasizes frontend engineering with React, ensuring seamless user experiences, responsive design, and tight integration with backend APIs. You’ll be expected to write clean, maintainable code, leverage popular React libraries, and deliver production-grade solutions.

Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and optimize complex web applications using React.
  • Build reusable, modular components with attention to scalability and performance.
  • Manage application state with libraries such as Redux, Zustand, or Recoil.
  • Ensure responsive, accessible, and pixel-perfect UI implementation (CSS-in-JS, Tailwind, Styled Components).
  • Integrate seamlessly with RESTful and GraphQL APIs.
  • Write unit and integration tests (Jest, React Testing Library, Cypress) to ensure application reliability.
  • Optimize applications for performance, bundle size, and loading speed.
  • Debug, profile, and resolve production issues to maintain a seamless user experience.

Core Skills & Experience

  • Expertise in React (Hooks, Context, functional components) and modern JavaScript (ES6+).
  • Strong experience with TypeScript for type safety and maintainability.
  • Proficiency with popular React libraries and tools such as:
  • Redux Toolkit / Zustand / Recoil (state management)
  • React Query / SWR / Apollo Client (data fetching and caching)
  • React Router (routing)
  • Styled Components / Tailwind / Emotion (styling)
  • Formik / React Hook Form (forms and validation)
  • Jest & React Testing Library / Cypress (testing)
  • Solid understanding of modern build tools (Webpack, Vite, Babel).
  • Strong knowledge of version control (Git) and collaborative workflows.
  • Familiarity with accessibility (WCAG standards) and performance optimization best practices.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with SSR/SSG frameworks (Next.js, Remix).
  • Familiarity with design systems (Storybook, Radix UI, Material UI).
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and frontend deployment processes.
  • Exposure to backend technologies (Ruby on Rails, Node.js) to collaborate effectively with backend teams.
  • Knowledge of GraphQL schemas and API design.

title: Bolsista Graduado - Grupo Boticário - Substituição de Matérias Primas e Embalagens Controversas | Talento Inovação -IEL/PR
description:
O Programa Talento Inovação do IEL Paraná tem como foco selecionar, acompanhar e desenvolver bolsistas, além de coordenar ações com organizações parceiras. Ele convida indústrias a proporem projetos de Pesquisa, Desenvolvimento e Inovação ( PD&I ) nos quais a participação dos bolsistas promova o crescimento profissional em PD&I empresarial e contribua para a inovação da empresa.

O programa oferece bolsas para graduandos, graduados, mestres e doutores, permitindo atividades de PD&I nas instalações das empresas pelo território nacional, após aprovação da Comissão Interna do IEL Paraná.

Projeto: Substituição de Matérias Primas e Embalagens Controversas

Sobre a Oportunidade:

Sustentabilidade e inovação estão no DNA do Grupo Boticário — e você pode fazer parte dessa transformação. Estamos em busca de um talento comprometido e detalhista para conduzir o projeto de Substituição de Matérias-Primas e Embalagens Controversas , uma iniciativa estratégica que unirá pesquisa, desenvolvimento e responsabilidade socioambiental para fortalecer nosso portfólio de produtos.

Você terá a oportunidade de atuar na identificação e aplicação de alternativas seguras e sustentáveis para matérias-primas, considerando aspectos ambientais, regulatórios e de segurança humana. Seu trabalho será essencial para garantir a performance, qualidade e viabilidade econômica das soluções, contribuindo para o cumprimento dos compromissos 2030 do Grupo Boticário.

Se você deseja aplicar seu conhecimento técnico em um ambiente colaborativo e inovador, liderando iniciativas que unem ciência, propósito e impacto real no mercado, e quer contribuir para uma indústria de cosméticos mais sustentável, essa vaga é para você.

Formação Acadêmica: Graduado em Química, Farmácia, Eng. Química, Biotecnologia e cursos afins.

Principais Atividades:

  • Avaliação das matérias primas e materiais de embalagens controversas que precisam de substituição bem como o estudo das fórmulas e composições que serão aplicadas.
  • Identificação de possíveis substitutos (contato com fornecedores, pesquisa bibliográfica, estudo das literaturas, comparações entre alternativas.)
  • Aplicação dos substitutos nos produt
  • os do portfólio que utilizam a Matéria prima ou Material Embalagem Controversa.
  • Avaliação de performance, atributos de qualidade e físico-químicos, versus o produto que necessita de substituição.
  • Submissão das formulações e embalagens para estudo de estabilidade, compatibilidade, análises organolépticas, físico-químicas, funcionais versus o produto atual.
  • Avaliação e possíveis impactos no processo de fabricação e envase.
  • Avaliação e impactos relacionados a custo e margem
  • Avaliação e impacto relacionado a abastecimento de insumo.

Conhecimentos Necessários:

  • Conhecimento em tecnologia de emulsões, produtos enxaguáveis e maquiagem.
  • Experiência prática em manipulação de cosméticos.
  • Conhecimento em emulsionantes, emolientes, polímeros, formadores de filme e tensoativos disponíveis no mercado.
  • Pensamento analítico e crítico apurados.

Conhecimentos Desejáveis:

  • Foco no consumidor e curiosidade para entender os fatores de compra e fidelização.
  • Conhecimento em estudos de estabilidade e processos produtivos.
  • Experiência prévia na área de P&D.
  • Conhecimento em materiais de embalagem (Polipropileno, Polietileno, PET, ABS, Papel, Alumínio) e processos de fabricação de embalagem: injeção, sopro.

Conhecimentos de Informática:

  • Domínio do Pacote Office.

Idioma:

Soft Skills:

  • Proatividade e iniciativa para resolver problemas e buscar soluções inovadoras.

  • Facilidade para trabalhar em equipe e engajar diversos perfis profissionais.
  • Orientação a resultados, com foco em qualidade e prazos.

ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.

Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.

E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

title: Implementation/Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
Implementation / Forward Deployed Engineer - Canada, Mexico, South America - Remote

About us

VERSA AI is an innovative and fast-growing start-up in the Contact Center automation space - designing and deploying next generation voice Ai Agents. We’re on a mission to build and support the Contact Center of the future using the power of Ai to create beautiful conversations between humans and machines.

Our technology helps clients deliver exceptional customer experiences whilst simultaneously cutting costs and managing growth. An Australian-founded business with a strong foothold in the US, we are looking to expand our operations and build out our team on the ground in this critical market. We are looking for passionate, entrepreneurial individuals who are eager to make a significant impact in a dynamic and fast-moving environment.

Who we are looking for

A versatile Full Stack Engineer who can move from discovery to delivery with minimal hand-holding. You are strongest in Node.js on AWS, comfortable with IaC, and fluent in stitching together APIs, LLMs, SIP telephony and cloud services to ship reliable, production value fast. You think in systems, automate what repeats, and write clear, testable code. You enjoy working directly with clients, translating goals into pragmatic workflows, then owning the build, rollout and measurement. You communicate crisply with both engineers and non-technical partners, collaborate with internal stakeholders, and leave things better than you found them through improved tooling, documentation and dashboards.

Required Experience:

  • 5 - 8 years of professional engineering experience, ideally across full-stack development and you have a strong understanding of engineering principles.
  • Strong background in system integration, workflow automation, and API-driven development utilising Node.js and AWS.
  • Proven ability to work directly with clients and colleagues, build trust, and translate business needs into technical solutions.
  • Exceptional communication skills to collaborate effectively with both technical and non-technical teams.
  • Comfortable operating in fast-paced environments with a high level of autonomy. Working independently is highly important in this role.

Key Responsibilities

  • Integration between LLM’s, SIP Telephony, API endpoints and cloud infrastructure (AWS) using mostly NodeJs and IAC.
  • Partner with clients to design and implement automation workflows that align with their roadmap upon onboarding of new clients.
  • Develop, integrate, and maintain full-stack features to deliver immediate value in production.
  • Act as both engineer and consultant: uncovering client challenges, advising on solutions, and building them in collaboration with the clients technical team.
  • Collaborate internally with the Customer Success and Conversation Design teams to translate to technical requirements and ensure seamless delivery.
  • Contribute to improving internal tooling, documentation and frameworks for faster client implementations.

What success looks like

In the first 30 days you will map our architecture, run the product locally and in staging, and set yourself up with logs and monitoring. You will close a first batch of low risk tickets, ship a couple of small peer-reviewed fixes, and improve at least one run book.

In the next few months, you will be a trusted technical support partner who triages and resolves incidents end to end, consistently meets SLAs, and owns a service area with clear dashboards and documentation. You will reduce repeat issues through small automations or fixes, contribute to RCAs, and share knowledge with the team.

The benefits

The Versa Group has been recognised both in Australia and internationally for

creating a highly innovative environment for our employees. In 2019 Versa were

named as only one of eight companies outside of the US in Fast Company’s Top 50

Workplaces for Innovators.

  • Be part of a fast-growing start-up with a dynamic and innovative culture.
  • Opportunity for significant professional growth and career advancement.
  • Competitive salary and commission structure.
  • Highly flexible work environment with a ‘remote first’ company

We believe that diversity is critical to our success. We will not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or marital, veteran, or disability status.

title: Project Manager
description:
Company Description

Charly Agency is a globally operating digital agency based in Barcelona, Spain. We specialize in providing top-quality design, technology, and marketing services to drive businesses to success. Our clientele is 90% based in the USA. Our commitment to excellence is evident in client testimonials, highlighting our responsiveness, dedication, and impressive results. Our key capabilities include web design, web and mobile app design, brand strategy and design, ecommerce and CRO, web development and maintenance, SEO, and content writing.

Role Description

This position at Charly Agency offers a dynamic opportunity. As a Project Manager, you'll lead diverse digital projects, from web design and development to UX design and branding. You’ll coordinate closely with cross-functional teams, ensuring deliverables meet the highest quality standards. This role is not limited to traditional project management; it requires a hands-on approach—whether supporting the team with copywriting, compiling reports, or conducting quality assurance checks.

We’re looking for someone detail-oriented and adaptable, with the ability to see the big picture, a great sense of ownership, and an understanding of how individual tasks contribute to overall project success. Strong communication skills are essential for liaising with designers, developers, clients, and internal team members, ensuring that all deliverables align with our standards and client expectations.

This is a remote contractor position.

Key Responsibilities

Project Management:

  • Plan, execute, and oversee digital projects from inception to completion, ensuring they are delivered on time, within scope, and to high-quality standards.
  • Coordinate with designers, developers, and technical teams to align project goals and deliverables.
  • Conduct thorough quality assurance checks to ensure all deliverables meet client and agency standards.
  • Monitor project timelines and resources, addressing any deviations proactively.
  • Follow up diligently with team members to ensure progress aligns with project milestones.

Hands-On Contribution:

  • Support with content tasks, such as drafting or reviewing copy.
  • Assist in compiling and analyzing reports to provide insights to clients or internal teams.
  • Be prepared to learn new skills and adapt to emerging project needs.

Communication:

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for clients, maintaining clear and effective communication.
  • Translate technical or design concepts into terms easily understood by all stakeholders.
  • Facilitate collaboration across teams, ensuring everyone is aligned and informed.

Qualifications

  • 2-5 years of experience in project management within digital agencies, product development, web design, UX design, or related fields.
  • High attention to detail and the ability to see the broader strategic picture.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with proficiency in English.
  • Proven ability to coordinate cross-functional teams and manage multiple priorities.
  • Strong organizational skills and a proactive approach to problem-solving.
  • Basic understanding of web design and development processes.
  • Flexibility to adapt to evolving project requirements and learn new tools or methods as needed.
  • International exposure (work or study abroad, exchange programs) is a plus.

What We Offer

  1. Meaningful Impact: Contribute directly to projects that shape the trajectory of the company and its clients.
  2. Engaging Work: Take on diverse tasks and challenging projects in a fast-paced environment.
  3. Flexibility: Enjoy the benefits of a remote position with flexible working hours.
  4. Competitive Compensation Package:
  • Salary: $1,500-$2,000 per month based on experience, composed of a base salary and performance bonuses.
  • Communication Support: Receive $50 monthly to cover communication expenses.
  1. Generous PTO: Take advantage of 3 weeks of paid time off per year to recharge and pursue personal interests.

Application Process

To apply you can do a quick apply on linkedin or, preferably send your CV, cover letter, and a 1-minute video introducing yourself and your experience to using the subject: “Project Manager Application - (Your Full Name).”

We look forward to reviewing your application and assessing your fit for this exciting role!

title: Baker Role - 42981
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies, accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM, and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.

Role Overview

Turing is seeking baking professionals to join the Common Lives Project —a research initiative to collect real-world footage that trains AI systems. You and a colleague from the same bakery or workspace will wear GoPro cameras while baking and managing prep throughout the day.

Responsibilities:

  • Wear a head-mounted GoPro camera to capture daily activities for 5 separate days within a 2-week window
  • Record a minimum of 7 hours per day, with flexibility to take breaks and pause the camera for privacy
  • At the end of each day, spend around 2 hours to:
  • Upload your footage to a secure platform
  • Review short clips
  • Choose to delete, anonymize, or consent to each video segment

Household Requirements:

  • No children (under 18) present or visiting during the recording period
  • All adults in the space must be fluent English speakers and consent to being recorded
  • Must live in a private, self-contained apartment, building, or indoor work environment
  • All household members must agree to appear in the footage

Participant Requirements:

  • Must work indoors in non-customer-facing roles (e.g., not retail or child care)
  • Participants who share the same workplace or household should both have a GoPro mounted during the activity.
  • Preferably engaged in manual or creative work (e.g., chef, baker, artist, carpenter, musician, electrician, mechanic)
  • Must be self-employed or have employer consent to record in the work environment
  • Able to use a computer for basic tasks such as reviewing and uploading video clips

Technical Requirements:

  • Must have access to a computer and internet connection
  • Comfortable using web-based tools for uploading and reviewing clips (training will be provided)
  • GoPro camera and all accessories will be provided for the duration of the project

Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Play a vital role in shaping the future of human-centered AI research
  • Short-term, flexible engagement with minimal disruption to your routine
  • All equipment provided by Turing
  • Be part of an innovative global data collection initiative

Offer Details:

  • Commitment Required: 5 recording days within a 2-week window
  • Engagement Type: Contractor / Freelance
  • Duration: 2 weeks (plus setup and review time)
  • Location: India, Brazil, Colombia

Application Process:

  • Shortlisted candidates will be contacted for a brief screening
  • Once accepted, Turing will ship all necessary equipment and provide onboarding instructions
  • Participants will receive training on how to record, upload, and review their footage securely

  • Auditorias e Fiscalizações: Coordenar e apoiar os processos de auditoria interna e externa, bem como atender a fiscalizações, fornecendo as informações e documentos necessários.

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description:
About the Role

We are looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer with deep expertise in AWS cloud infrastructure to strengthen our DevOps culture and help scale our systems securely and reliably.

What You’ll Do

  • Design, implement, and maintain highly scalable and secure cloud infrastructure on AWS .
  • Develop and optimize IaC (Infrastructure as Code) pipelines.
  • Ensure observability and monitoring across services and environments.
  • Implement security best practices and compliance controls across infrastructure.
  • Support and prepare systems for external audits and licensing requirements .
  • Improve CI/CD workflows and accelerate developer productivity.
  • Lead and mentor junior engineers in DevOps best practices.

What We’re Looking For

  • Senior-level experience in DevOps and cloud infrastructure.
  • Proven expertise in AWS services (EC2, ECS/EKS, RDS, Lambda, S3, VPC, IAM, CloudFormation/Terraform, etc.).
  • Strong background in a utomation, scalability, and system reliability.
  • Knowledge of containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and modern monitoring stacks.
  • Strong security-first mindset and experience with compliance or audit-ready infrastructure.
  • Advanced English proficiency, for effective communication in international contexts and during audits/compliance processes.

Why Join Us

  • At Bloquo, you’ll work at the intersection of cloud, payments, and blockchain innovation. You’ll have the autonomy to design world-class infrastructure and the chance to shape the reliability and security of systems that enable cross-border transactions in real time, ensuring compliance with evolving regulatory and licensing requirements.

A área de Tesouraria é responsável por realizar a gestão do caixa, suas projeções e alocações, bem como cuidar das necessidades de funding , liquidez e riscos da empresa (de liquidez, mercado etc.). Além dos controles de caixa e riscos, a Tesouraria tem como objetivo a constante avaliação do melhor modelo de gestão de recursos e a otimização o P&L da empresa, por meio da diversificação das estratégias de investimentos e captações de recursos com taxas e spreads mais competitivas.

Atividades:

  • Liderar a equipe de contas a pagar e contas a receber;
  • Organizar taticamente como implementar estratégia e objetivos definidos para a área;
  • Análise do fluxo de caixa, para gerir liquidez e capacidade de pagamento no curto e longo prazo;
  • Otimizar as sobras de recursos e garantir que sejam devidamente investidas no melhor risco e retorno;
  • Desenhar e executar as estratégias de funding de curto e longo prazo e derivativos (SWAP) com objetivo de hedge;
  • Conduzir a negociação de cotações das operações de captação junto aos bancos, sempre visando maior rentabilidade;
  • Precificação periódica das nossas ferramentas de cotação de contratos de aluguel com base no custo de captação corrente & estimado;
  • Benchmark de custo financeiro, spread bancário médio e outros KPIs entre empresas do mesmo setor;
  • Monitorar outros KPIs relevantes como a alavancagem, estrutura de capital, necessidades de capital ( Equity );
  • Responsável por desenvolver e controlar os limites de crédito junto aos bancos parceiros e, sempre que necessário, ampliar limites e parcerias para garantir a liquidez;
  • Desenvolver e implementar melhoria processos visando melhoria na qualidade e produtividade
  • Interação periódica e preparação de reportes mensais para o time de ALM global;
  • Conhecimentos em mercado de capitais;
  • Experiencia em cálculos financeiros (juros simples, exponencial, ;
  • Preparar e monitorar budget/forecast, identificar desvios e ações para correções.

Responsabilidades ambientais:

Realizar a prática da coleta seletiva no setor, cumprir com a política, objetivos, procedimentos e diretrizes ambientais, ter conhecimento dos seus aspectos e impactos ambientais significativos, contribuir com melhorias voltadas a proteção do meio ambiente e multiplicar o conhecimento sobre as melhores práticas ambientais sempre que possível a todos os colaboradores que atuam em sua área.

Competências Comportamentais:

  • Excelente comunicação com diversos níveis hierárquicos;
  • Excelente habilidade de negociação e influência;
  • Excelente habilidade de liderança de pessoas e projetos;
  • Excelente habilidade de gestão de conflitos e imprevistos;
  • Excelente organização e gestão de prioridades.

Requisitos Técnicos:

  • Graduação completa em Finanças, Contabilidade, Administração ou Engenharia e desejável pós-graduação;
  • Larga experiência em todas as atividades relacionados a gestão de tesouraria, contas a pagar, contas a receber, fluxo de caixa, gestão de loans e forte relacionamento com Banco;
  • Excel e Inglês avançados.
  • Matemática financeira

title: Pessoa Executiva Comercial - Grandes Contas - Mercado Pago
description:
Descrição da Oportunidade:

No Mercado Livre estamos democratizando o comércio e os serviços financeiros para transformar a vida das pessoas na América Latina. Faça parte deste propósito!

Nosso negócio Fintech oferece para toda a região uma proposta de valor integral, que visa democratizar os serviços financeiros e satisfazer as necessidades de mais de 60 milhões de usuários e usuárias.

Disponibilizamos uma plataforma online que permite receber pelas vendas eletrônicas realizadas, tanto dentro como fora do Mercado Livre, e um sistema de códigos QR e dispositivos Point para as vendas realizadas no mundo físico.

Para milhões de comerciantes, empreendedores e profissionais, damos a possibilidade de processar suas operações com segurança, através de mais de 50 meios de pagamento na América Latina.

Além disso, fornecemos acesso gratuito a uma conta digital que permite pagar, enviar e receber dinheiro, gerar renda e trabalhar com cartões para fazer compras ou saques.

Através do Mercado Crédito, concedemos créditos para satisfazer as necessidades daqueles a quem prestamos nossos serviços e potencializar os negócios de quem vende através da nossa plataforma.

Temos um desafio para as pessoas que:

  • Vibram energia empreendedora: são movidas pela curiosidade, nunca desistem e estão focadas em superar seus próprios limites.
  • Dão o máximo, porque adoram trabalhar com compromisso e dedicação.
  • Encaram as mudanças como oportunidades e aprendem com seus erros.
  • A excelência e a execução são primordiais na sua forma de fazer as coisas.
  • Promovem o bom clima, a alegria e a diversão.
  • Sabem como construir com outras pessoas e desfrutam trabalhando em equipe.

Imagine você empreendendo projetos desafiadores, dinâmicos e inovadores, e sendo responsável por:

  • Trazer novos clientes para o canal, com perfil Grandes Contas .
  • Atuar no funil inteiro de vendas, desde prospecção, qualificação e negociação.
  • Acompanhar e analisar relatórios de atividades, assim como a eficiência do canal considerando dois KPIS, Volume Total de Pagamentos e Receitas.
  • Garantir o desenvolvimento do canal, participando ativamente na estruturação da metodologia, processos e, até mesmo, produto. Trazendo inputs para áreas responsáveis, representando os clientes e acelerando as melhorias.
  • Acompanhamento e compartilhamento das ações das concorrências, através de potenciais clientes, mercado e entorno competitivo diretos e indiretos.

Requisitos:

  • Possuir formação superior completa e/ou cursando.
  • Experiência em canais de vendas com foco em aquisição e formação de carteira de clientes.
  • Desejável conhecimentos em Adquirência.

Nós lhe propomos:

  • Ser parte de uma empresa com espírito empreendedor, na qual adoramos pensar grande e em longo prazo.
  • Ser protagonista de seu desenvolvimento em um ambiente de oportunidades, aprendizagem, crescimento, expansão e projetos desafiadores.
  • Compartilhar e aprender em equipe, com excelentes profissionais e especialistas.
  • Um excelente clima de trabalho, com todo o necessário para você viver uma grande experiência. :)

O Mercado Livre não faz contato oferecendo oportunidades em troca de pagamento de dinheiro. Você tem acesso a todas as oportunidades abertas no nosso site de carreiras. Caso receba pedidos de dinheiro, desconfie!

title: Javascript - Agentic/GenAI Engineer
description:
Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary

As a Software Engineer focused on Artificial Intelligence, you will make a significant contribution to the construction of innovative AI Agents by collaborating closely with your engineering peers. This role requires a high degree of creative thinking and a strong willingness to learn, as you will be working with the latest in Generative AI tools and frameworks. The Agentic AI Engineer explores emerging technologies, promotes new development approaches, and helps shape the standards for intelligent automation, playing a fundamental role in advancing the company's AI-driven solutions.

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Lead the design, architecture, and development of autonomous AI Agents, leveraging LLMs, advanced techniques such as RAG, and agent-specific frameworks;
  • Develop full-stack applications that support and interact with AI Agents, using JavaScript/TypeScript, React, and Next.js to build the necessary interfaces and systems;
  • Explore and experiment with emerging technologies and frameworks in the agentic space, fostering innovation and shaping best practices;
  • Collaborate with product and design teams to define the behavior, capabilities, and goals of AI Agents, translating business requirements into robust agentic solutions;
  • Ensure code quality through rigorous reviews, testing, and documentation, while mentoring other engineers on development best practices.

Essential Skills

  • Solid experience in software engineering and full-stack development, with proficiency in JavaScript, TypeScript, and React;
  • Hands-on and up-to-date knowledge of Generative AI, including experience building and implementing features with LLMs in real-world products;
  • Strong foundation in software engineering principles, including system design, API architecture, code quality, and testing.

Highly Desirable Skills

title: Artist Gig (Record & Earn $20/hr) - 42981
description:
Role Overview

Are you an artist working closely with another creator or assistant in your studio? Turing is looking for artists to wear GoPros and record their daily creative process as part of the Common Lives Project . This data will train AI to understand creativity, hands-on collaboration, and real-world artistic routines.

Responsibilities

  • Wear a head-mounted GoPro camera to capture daily activities for 5 separate days within a 2-week window
  • Record a minimum of 7 hours per day, with flexibility to take breaks and pause the camera for privacy
  • At the end of each day, spend around 2 hours to:
  • Upload your footage to a secure platform
  • Review short clips
  • Choose to delete, anonymize, or consent to each video segment

Household Requirements:

  • No children (under 18) present or visiting during the recording period
  • All adults in the space must be fluent English speakers and consent to being recorded
  • Must live in a private, self-contained apartment, building, or indoor work environment
  • All household members must agree to appear in the footage

Participant Requirements:

  • Must work indoors in non-customer-facing roles (e.g., not retail or child care)
  • Participants who share the same workplace or household should both have a GoPro mounted during the activity.
  • Preferably engaged in manual or creative work (e.g., chef, baker, artist, carpenter, musician, electrician, mechanic)
  • Must be self-employed or have employer consent to record in the work environment
  • Able to use a computer for basic tasks such as reviewing and uploading video clips

Technical Requirements:

  • Must have access to a computer and internet connection
  • Comfortable using web-based tools for uploading and reviewing clips (training will be provided)
  • GoPro camera and all accessories will be provided for the duration of the project

Perks of Freelancing With Turing

  • Play a vital role in shaping the future of human-centered AI research
  • Short-term, flexible engagement with minimal disruption to your routine
  • All equipment provided by Turing
  • Be part of an innovative global data collection initiative

Offer Details

  • Commitment Required: 5 recording days within a 2-week window
  • Engagement Type: Contractor / Freelance
  • Duration: 2 weeks (plus setup and review time)
  • Location: India, Brazil, Colombia

Application Process

  • Shortlisted candidates will be contacted for a brief screening
  • Once accepted, Turing will ship all necessary equipment and provide onboarding instructions
  • Participants will receive training on how to record, upload, and review their footage securely

title: Mobile App Developer
description:
Company Description

kuubiik is a global consulting firm headquartered in Singapore, with operations in over 150 countries. Specializing in outsourcing and project-based solutions for various business functions, our team comprises professionals from diverse regions, including Asia, Europe, and the Americas. Trusted by renowned brands like Google, TikTok, AEM, HP, TELUS, MyRepublic, and SGS, kuubiik offers flexible staffing solutions, ranging from hourly outsourcing to full-time or part-time engagements.

Job Title : Mobile Application Developer

Client location : US

Timezone : EST

Job type : Full-time, remote

Monthly salary : USD 1,500

Role Description

One of our clients is looking for a Frontend & Mobile Developer with deep expertise in JavaScript , React , and mobile frameworks like React Native and Flutter . This is a hands-on role with significant ownership over the frontend and mobile codebases across web and app platforms.

You'll be instrumental in shaping the future of our mobile and frontend experiences, with a focus on performance, scalability, and seamless cross-platform functionality.

Key Requirements

  • Lead development of mobile apps using React Native (or Flutter during transition)
  • Maintain and evolve existing Ionic/Capacitor apps during migration phase
  • Build and maintain responsive frontend interfaces using React , HTML , CSS , and modern JavaScript
  • Integrate with backend services (Laravel, MySQL) and coordinate with backend team
  • Implement in-app subscriptions/payments (Apple, Google, etc.)
  • Handle device-specific functionality: geolocation , camera/video , background services , notifications
  • Optimize UX for mobile and web platforms

Must-Have Qualifications

  • 3+ years of frontend development experience with JavaScript , HTML , CSS
  • 3+ years using React (React Native experience strongly preferred)
  • Experience with at least one of the following: Flutter , Capacitor/Ionic , Swift/Kotlin
  • Deep knowledge of mobile device features & APIs (camera, geolocation, background services, etc.)
  • Hands-on experience with in-app payments , App Store / Play Store integrations
  • Familiarity with Laravel , Vue , MySQL (not core, but nice to have)

Nice-To-Have

  • Experience migrating mobile apps from legacy stacks (e.g., Ionic → React Native)
  • Familiarity with Apple/Google developer ecosystems and publishing processes
  • Exposure to performance monitoring and crash analytics tools (Firebase, Sentry, etc.)

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
The company and our mission:

Zartis is a digital solutions provider working across technology strategy, software engineering and product development.

We partner with firms across financial services, MedTech, media, logistics technology, renewable energy, EdTech, e-commerce, and more. Our engineering hubs in EMEA and LATAM are full of talented professionals delivering business success and digital improvement across application development, software architecture, CI/CD, business intelligence, QA automation, and new technology integrations.

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to work on a project in the modern healthcare industry.

The project:

You will be joining the Booking team, contributing to a platform that simplifies healthcare appointment scheduling for millions of patients and providers. In this role, you’ll help shape how key information - such as insurance details - is collected and validated, ensuring a seamless booking journey.

Your work will center on evolving data models, improving system performance, and strengthening the reliability of a high-volume booking system. By collaborating with experienced engineers, you’ll extend and optimize microservices in the booking domain, driving scalability, cost efficiency, and stability. This is an opportunity to apply deep technical expertise while making a meaningful impact in a distributed, innovation-driven environment.

What you will do:

- Building large-scale APIs and microservices, creating frictionless data flows that empower both patients and providers to access care and information in real time.

- Mentoring fellow engineers, supercharging team throughput through robust coding standards, automated workflows, and a culture of continuous improvement.

- Spearheading bold innovation, whether it’s adopting generative AI, exploring emerging data sources, or pioneering architectural strategies that keep the platform ahead in healthcare tech.

- Decomposing complex product challenges to drive sound design decisions.

- Collaborating with an agile team of engineers, product managers, and designers.

- Working with cutting-edge GenAI tools and technology.

What you will bring:

- Inspiration to positively impact the healthcare experience of millions of patients and providers.

- A product-driven mindset with relentless focus on user needs.

- Strong autonomy, accountability, and comfort in a remote-first environment.

- Passion for engineering fundamentals and promoting best practices in code health, testing, and maintainability.

- Commitment to fostering diverse and inclusive teams and culture.

- Entrepreneurial spirit with strong ownership, thriving in fast-changing and ambiguous environments.

- Ability to craft database schemas, implement REST APIs, and design event-driven queue and stream processing systems, ideally with C#, .NET Core, and AWS.

- A history of solid and well-rounded system design skills.

- Leadership by example in testing, deployment, and observability practices.

- Excellent communication skills: able to dive into technical detail with engineers while presenting clear solutions to non-technical audiences.

- Comfort working with distributed teams.

- Experience integrating generative AI tools into daily workflows to automate tasks, drive innovation, and maximize productivity.

What we offer:

- 100% Remote Work.

- WFH allowance: Monthly payment as financial support for remote working.

- Career Growth: We have established a career development program accessible for all employees with a 360º feedback that will help us to guide you in your career progression.

- Training: For Tech training at Zartis, you have time allocated during the week at your disposal. You can request from a variety of options, such as online courses (from Pluralsight and Educative.io, for example), English classes, books, conferences, and events.

- Mentoring Program: You can become a mentor in Zartis or you can receive mentorship, or both.

- Zartis Wellbeing Hub (Kara Connect) : A platform that provides sessions with a range of specialists, including mental health professionals, nutritionists, physiotherapists, fitness coaches, and webinars with such professionals as well.

- Multicultural working environment: We organize tech events, webinars, parties, and activities to do online team-building games and contests.

description:
Sobre REDE SANTA CATARINA

Há 120 anos no Brasil, a Associação Congregação de Santa Catarina (ACSC) é responsável pela administração de 19 entidades com atuação social, em saúde e educação, que formam a Rede Santa Catarina. Com um modelo de gestão em que o superávit gerado é aplicado em nossas obras a fim de executar dignamente nossas atividades, a instituição acolhe e cuida do ser humano em todo o ciclo da vida. Ao todo são cerca de 10,5 mil colaboradores distribuídos em diversas instituições de saúde, mantendo inúmeros estabelecimentos de ensino e acolhendo crianças, adultos e idosos em espaços assistenciais, com atendimento humanizado e serviços de qualidade para milhares de pessoas em seis Estados brasileiros (Espírito Santo, Goiás, Minas Gerais, Rio de Janeiro, Santa Catarina e São Paulo).

MISSÃO: Acolher e cuidar do ser humano durante todo o ciclo da vida.

VISÃO: Ser referência de entidade filantrópica reconhecida pela sociedade, demonstrando amor às pessoas por meio de nossos atos.

  • Capacidade de análise de dados em grande volume e desenho de fluxos operacionais.
  • Vivência em empresas do setor de Saúde e Educação será um diferencial.

“A Rede Santa Catarina respeita, promove e apoia a inclusão. Nossas vagas são abertas para atrair talentos diversos, valorizando todas as características independentemente de deficiência, raça, etnia, gênero, idade, orientação sexual ou religião.”

title: Executivo (a) Pré-Vendas Técnicas
description:
Vaga: Executivo(a) Comercial Pleno – Pré-Vendas

Se você domina tecnologia e tem perfil comercial, venha construir soluções que fazem a diferença para os clientes.

Atue como especialista técnico em soluções digitais, conectando os desafios de negócio dos clientes às nossas soluções, construindo fluxos e configurações em plataformas low code.

Principais responsabilidades:

  • Apoiar tecnicamente na qualificação de oportunidades comerciais, auxiliando a equipe de vendas na demonstração da plataforma e aplicações da solução com casos práticos;
  • Atuar como especialista técnico, conectando os desafios de negócio dos clientes às soluções da empresa;
  • Conduzir reuniões com clientes em conjunto com a área de Vendas Diretas, Canais e Parcerias;
  • Colaborar com Produto, Desenvolvimento, Marketing e Customer Success na elaboração de propostas;
  • Desenvolver e apresentar soluções SaaS, Telecom e Omnichannel;
  • Apoiar na elaboração de propostas, POCs e demonstrações técnicas;
  • Produzir análises e relatórios sobre leads, oportunidades e performance de vendas.

Requisitos e competências:

  • Formação em Tecnologia, Engenharia, Sistemas ou áreas afins ;
  • Experiência na área comercial, com vendas diretas B2B em tecnologia;
  • Conhecimento em soluções SaaS (chatbot, URA, Omnichannel, e agentes de IA);
  • Habilidade em negociação, apresentação de soluções e construção de relacionamentos;
  • Vivência com CRM de vendas e integração de APIs.

O que oferecemos:

  • Vale-refeição/alimentação

title: Videomaker
description:
Vaga: Videomaker

Local:Florianópolis (Híbrido: 3 a 4 vezes por semana presencial)

Sobre a vaga:

Somos uma produtora de vídeo com atuação nacional, especializada em criar conteúdos que conectam pessoas, marcas e experiências. Nosso portfólio é bem diversificado e reflete nosso compromisso em entregar materiais que realmente impactem e gerem resultado para nossos clientes.

Se você é apaixonado(a) por produção de conteúdo visual e tem habilidades com captação e edição de vídeos, essa oportunidade é para você!

Estamos buscando um(a) Videomaker criativo(a) para integrar nosso time e ajudar a dar vida aos nossos projetos com materiais impactantes!

Principais responsabilidades:

  • Captar e editar vídeos de alta qualidade para eventos, campanhas, bastidores, redes sociais e outros projetos audiovisuais;
  • Editar imagens e vídeos garantindo alinhamento estético e identidade visual da marca;
  • Realizar edições dinâmicas e criativas de vídeos curtos e longos, incluindo cortes, efeitos e legendas quando necessário.
  • Produzir motion graphics e animações simples.
  • Colaborar com equipes de marketing, design e outros departamentos para produzir conteúdos estratégicos e criativos;
  • Participar do planejamento criativo de campanhas, sugerindo melhorias e novas ideias inovadoras.

Requisitos:

  • Computador próprio que suporte edições de vídeo e imagem de alta performance;
  • Experiência com ferramentas de edição de vídeo (ex.: dobe Premiere, Final Cut, DaVinci Resolve (After Effects é um diferencial))
  • Criatividade, atenção aos detalhes e organização.
  • Experiência comprovada como videomaker e editor de vídeo (com envio de portfólio)
  • Experiência com captação de eventos
  • Habilidade para trabalhar com efeitos, animações, criação e customização de trilhas e efeitos sonoros, além de correção de cores.
  • Capacidade de gerenciar o tempo de forma eficaz e cumprir prazos rigorosamente.
  • Proatividade para sugerir ideias e abordagens inovadoras para diferentes projetos.
  • Morar em Florianópolis e Região ou estar disposto a se mudar para a cidade.

Diferenciais:

  • Modelo de trabalho híbrido, com base em Florianópolis.
  • Salário competitivo.
  • Ambiente que promove rápido crescimento e desenvolvimento de habilidades.
  • Oportunidade de atuar em diversas frentes, nichos e tipos de clientes dentro do audiovisual.

title: Remote C++ Developer
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.

Overview of the role:

We are looking for C++ Developers to join our Development team and participate in different projects made up of multicultural teams distributed worldwide. We are looking for proactive people and team players passionate about programming in this language and oriented to provide the best experience to the end user. This is an excellent opportunity for those professionals looking to develop in one of the fastest-growing companies in the industry!

These developers will face numerous technical challenges, so they must use current technologies, and get involved in the mobile world, web applications, devices, etc.

- Defining, developing, testing, analyzing, and maintaining real-time applications against defined interfaces.

- Find bottlenecks and defects in code and come up with remedies.

- Maintain code quality, design, and refactoring for optimal performance.

- Work with the BA, QA, operational, and cross-functional application teams to resolve data quality and performance concerns.

- 6+ years of experience working as a developer.

- 5+ years of experience in C++.

- Proficient with analysis, troubleshooting, and problem-solving.

title: Programador(a) Full-Stack
description:
Caso esteja interessado em se juntar a uma empresa ambiciosa que se motiva por desafios, você está no lugar certo. ● Realizar manutenção corretiva e evolutiva do sistema Meu Plano (backend em PHP e frontend HTML, CSS, JQuery, e aplicativo mobile em Angular + Ionic).

● Gerenciar e otimizar o banco de dados MySQL (produção e teste).

Diferenciais

● Experiência com segurança de aplicações web (criptografia,

description:

title: Account Executive
description:
Near is a startup focused on bridging the gap between remote Latin American talent and companies hiring in the US and abroad. Our team spans 20+ members across four different countries. We've landed numerous great customers and have helped hundreds of people from LatAm improve their lives and wallets with jobs at US companies.

We're looking for a driven and entrepreneurial Account Executive who is autonomous, creative, and enterprising to join our team. This is a financially rewarding opportunity with a highly competitive compensation structure – uncapped commission. If you can source and qualify leads effectively, you'll make a lot of money.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop and execute plans to achieve sales targets
  • Expand revenue originated from existing accounts
  • Create new opportunities through outbound prospecting.
  • Close inbound leads
  • Build and maintain strong, long-lasting customer relationships
  • Leverage our existing network to get referrals
  • Understand industry-specific landscapes and trends.
  • Become an expert in the staffing industry.

Qualifications:

  • Excellent communication skills.
  • Native-like English level
  • Demonstrated ability to problem solve and effectively manage time.
  • A proactive mindset: always pursuing your next goal.
  • Motivated by commission and career growth.
  • Track record of exceeding quota as SDR.

Traits that Would Make You a Strong Fit:

  • Proactive.
  • Optimistic and positive.
  • Intense, driving, and impatient (with regard to results and getting work done).
  • Pay attention to detail when necessary.
  • High EQ – can read the room and connect with people
  • Responds empathetic to others.
  • Follow-through skills.
  • Accountability

Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation.
  • Uncapped commission – the more you close, the higher your commission will be.
  • Results-focused role and team. No BS. No unnecessary processes and bureaucracy.
  • Opportunity to grow and work on larger and more complex deals.
  • A team with a great culture.
  • Join a team of high-performers.

Interview Process:

  • Assessment
  • Video Interview
  • Interview with COO
  • Final interview

description:

Ensino Médio Completo;

Empenho e dedicação para atingir metas e bons resultados;

Disponibilidade de horário.

title: Consultor de vendas
description:
Sobre a Egali

Aqui na Egali sonhamos alto! Somos centenas de pessoas apaixonadas pelo que fazemos. A nossa cultura é focada em construir um ambiente inclusivo e colaborativo, onde podemos ser a nossa melhor versão!

Sabemos que investir no potencial de nossos colaboradores é trazer ainda mais qualidade ao nosso negócio.

Requisitos:

  • Conhecimento em intercâmbio/Geolocalização.
  • Cursando Ensino superior nas áreas: Administração, Relações Internacionais, Administração, Comércio Exterior, Gestão Empresarial, Gestão Comercial e áreas correlatadas;

  • Organização e gestão do tempo também são habilidades fundamentais para esta posição;
  • Interesse e/ou experiencia com área comercial

  • Atender clientes via telefone, e-mail ou pessoalmente no escritório da empresa;

  • Prospectar novos leads.

title: General Manager Brazil - Seed Technologies
description:
Nufarm. Evolving Ag.

Nufarm is a global crop protection and seeds technologies company that helps farmers and businesses meet the global challenges of food, feed, fibre and food production.

Whether it’s developing the world’s first plant-based omega-3, launching precision agricultural solutions, unlocking biomass oils for more sustainable fuels and fast-moving consumer goods, launching innovative new crop protection solutions or delivering the crop and seed solutions farmers depend on every day, Nufarm is evolving with agriculture to drive value for customers.

Your Future. Fueled by Innovation

Reporting to the GM LAS, this role leads our Brazilian business end to end. You will set and execute the local commercial strategy, build a high-performing team, lift customer experience, strengthen the local supply chain, and drive the innovation pipeline to deliver both short-term results and long-term growth. This is a strong and growing business with significant future opportunities. You will also partner closely with the Nufarm Bioenergy platform lead and the Grain-to-Oil team to align and integrate plans, accelerating platform growth across Brazilian markets for the success of all portfolios.

As the GM, you will lead the Brazilian business, leveraging your expertise in the Brazilian seed industry and in-depth knowledge of business processes. Your key responsibilities include developing, refining, and implementing the three-year business strategy for the Brazilian Nufarm Seeds operations.

How You’ll Help Us Grow

  • Develop and grow the Brazilian team's commitment to prioritising health, safety and well-being
  • Lead a cross-functional leadership team of x across Brazil, Including: HR, Sales, Supply Chain, Market Development, Finance, Marketing/CX and Research & Development
  • Drive the development and implementation of the commercial strategy for the Brazilian business and grower adoption in sorghum, canola, carinata and energy cane.
  • Increase the addressable hybrid canola, sorghum, carinata and energy cane market through innovation and industry thought leadership.
  • Responsible for the P&L performance of the Brazilian Nufarm Seeds business.
  • Partner with the Nuseed Bioenergy platform lead, Global GM – Seeds and Grain-to-Oil team to integrate business plans and scale platform growth in Brazil
  • Ensure long range plans, budgets and forecasts are developed accurately and that the finance team partners with commercial and supply chain to meet the revenue and expense goals of the business.
  • Work with supply chain to ensure on-time delivery of high-quality canola seedwhile minimising obsolescence
  • Lead a thriving team across Brazil that continuously raises the bar. Work closely with managers to engage staff and build engagement while recruiting, developing and retaining top talent.
  • Work closely with local and global R&D team to support the portfolio development required. Understand and solve for the future challenges growers will face, ensuring our R&D efforts are focused on the traits we will need to successful on in future years.
  • Work with global business partners to strengthen the foundation of the business and drive for success.
  • Work to implement IBP and the surrounding analytics to ensure supply/demand decisions are made with all stakeholders in balance.
  • Work with internal and external grain-to-oil supply chain partners to identify pathways for integrating new platforms into the Brazilian business.
  • Create an enabling environment for new platforms (Bioenergy) through industry engagement and policy advocacy

DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA

Buscamos pessoas que sejam movidas por paixões como a que inspirou o nascimento do Grupo, e que juntamente conosco, estejam dispostas a assumirem os desafios e continuarem escrevendo nossa história!

Somos uma empresa de igualdade de oportunidades. Isso significa que, ao tomar decisões sobre a carreira de nossos colaboradores, nossas principais considerações são sua capacidade de realizar seu trabalho e se desenvolver em suas funções.

- Garantir a excelência no atendimento do cliente fidelizando o cliente com a marca e trazendo resultados para o atingimento de metas

- Acompanhar e orientar o time na jornada de vendas, interagindo e complementando quando visualiza oportunidades. Solucionar possíveis reclamações, trocas. Garantir que 100% da equipe realize os treinamentos online. Ser o multiplicador das estratégias da companhia, liderando pelo exemplo, sendo porta voz de todas as comunicações, garantindo a alta qualidade nos atendimentos

- Realizar o controle financeiro, fazendo depósitos semanais e preenchimento de planilhas, assim como controle do caixinha, prezando pelos gastos da loja afim de diminuir despesas. title: Global Feasibility Lead II
description:
Job Overview

The Global Feasibility Lead II will play an integral role in operational strategy and planning in the preaward space through participation in strategy development conversations, robust primary and secondary data collection and analysis, and development of feasibility and site selection strategies. In addition, the Global Feasibility Lead II will be responsible for managing global feasibility projects, working closely with representatives within the company to deliver robust feasibility reports to our customers. The Global Feasibility Lead II will transition the site selection strategy to operations in the post-award space by handing over relevant pre-award findings to the site selection team. The Global Feasibility Lead II will lead and/or contribute to process improvement and change initiatives within Feasibility, alongside training opportunities for departmental requirements and any other subjects that impact on feasibility conduct. The Global Feasibility Lead 2 role requires a diverse skill set; strong data mining and analytics skills, writing and presentation skills, and customer management skills are required. Comfort with participating in and/or leading client facing interactions as it relates to presenting feasibility related findings and recommendations is necessary.

Summary Of Responsibilities

  • Accountable for supporting the development, analyses, interpretation, and presentation of primary and secondary data in support of operational strategy and planning.
  • Conducts data mining of internal and external databases and initiates/oversees the collection of primary data for use in development of robust strategies for global clinical trials (country/site mix, site selection, enrollment modeling.).
  • Participates in the development of proposals and bid defenses; provides recommendations on the most appropriate use of data to support proposals and bid defense presentations, works with the team to identify potential risks, and is learning to propose effective solutions as appropriate.
  • Actively participates on cross-functional teams that plan, analyze, and present proposals and bid defenses as part of winning new business and maintaining client base.
  • Serves as functional bidder reviewer of the budget and text for proposals for which feasibility and/or site identification is included as the primary deliverable.
  • Leads cross functional teams in standalone feasibility efforts; responsible for final report creation and delivery, including discussion of findings and recommendations with external clients.
  • Participates in intra and inter-departmental meetings, leading/contributing to the presentation of information on feasibility offerings, demonstrating continued value-add of the department and providing training on best practices, processes and tools.
  • Develops networking abilities and has an ability/willingness to work with individuals across the globe.
  • Leads and/or contributes to process improvement or special projects within Feasibility.
  • Lead and/or contributes to development, implementation, and maintenance of systems within Feasibility.
  • Contributes to best practice for feasibility conduct.
  • Mentors junior team members (GFL1 or newer GFL2s as needed)
  • And all other duties as needed or assigned.

Qualifications (Minimum Required)

  • Associate degree with equivalent work experience.
  • Practical experience and understanding of global drug development and clinical trials including demonstrated experience for the mining, manipulating, and presenting of complex scientific data as it relates to clinical research and market analyses.

Experience (Minimum Required)

  • Candidates should have at least 4 years of working experience in an academic, science/health-related industry and at least 2 years of relevant experience in clinical research or a science/health-related industry. An associate degree is required; a master’s degree in a science-related discipline is preferred.
  • Position specific requirements:
  • Strong data mining and analytical skills.
  • Strong writing and presentation skills.
  • Upholds the highest standard of personal professionalism and work integrity.
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently.
  • Strong attention to detail/quality control skills.
  • Ability to successfully and quickly understand scientific information so as to be able to independently source data/information relevant to a scientific/medical strategy.
  • Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with team members, management, operations staff, clients, and executive management.
  • Demonstrated ability to handle multiple competing priorities effectively.
  • Negotiation and relationship management skills.
  • Experience in analyzing study and investigator performance metrics.
  • Self-motivated, works effectively under pressure.
  • Technical Requirements:
  • Excellent computer skills, including strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office and other data capture and compilation tools.
  • Established knowledge of tools used in obtaining critical market analyses of therapeutic pipelines.
  • Strong skills in scientific data manipulation, analysis, reporting, and maintenance.
  • Proven written and verbal communication skills, with strengths in independently gathering/presenting data in support of operational strategy and planning.

Learn more about our EEO & Accommodations request here .

title: Management Consultant - 46022
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies, accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM, and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.

Overview:

The ideal candidate is a structured thinker with a background in top-tier consulting. They bring a balance of analytical rigor and creative problem-solving, with demonstrated experience in building use cases, testing business scenarios, and critiquing ideas with precision. Candidates at Analyst level and above are welcome, provided they demonstrate the ability to work independently and, when required, to guide or collaborate effectively with peers.

What You will Work On:

  • Develop realistic business scenarios that account for both strategic and operational factors
  • Design structured use cases and consulting-style frameworks to address business challenges
  • Solve business case studies and scenario-driven problems with clarity and rigor
  • Critique proposed solutions, providing structured feedback on assumptions, logic, and clarity
  • Lead small teams when required, ensuring alignment and rigor in outcomes

Requirements:

  • 3+ years of experience at a leading consulting firm (McKinsey, Bain, BCG, or equivalent) in a strategy consulting role.
  • Strong analytical capability with demonstrated skill in structuring ambiguous problems
  • Creative mindset for developing scenarios and frameworks beyond standard templates
  • Clear and concise communication skills for both written and verbal outputs
  • Ability to take ownership of workstreams and drive outcomes independently

Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.

Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and minimum 20 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST. (We have 2 options of time commitment: 20 hrs/week or 40 hrs/week)
  • Engagement type: Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration of contract: 6 months

Evaluation Process:

  • Shortlisted candidates will be sent a job interest form
  • Based on the answers, you will be contacted to discuss the pre-onboarding requirements

title: Account Manager
description:
Job Title: Account Manager

Company Overview:

We are a fast-growing agency specializing in building high-converting Shopify pages for eCommerce brands. Our mission is to help Shopify brands convert users into loyal customers faster, increasing sales conversions and lowering their ad spend. We are looking for a highly organized and communicative Account Manager to help us manage communication between our clients and our design/development team.

Role Overview:

The Account Manager will serve as the primary contact for our clients, managing their needs and ensuring seamless communication between them and our design/development team. You will be responsible for driving projects forward, maintaining timelines, and keeping all stakeholders informed. Your role is essential to ensuring client satisfaction and successful project delivery. You will also handle minor updates to client websites using low-code tools such as Replo.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with clients, serving as their main point of contact.
  • Communicate client needs and expectations clearly to the design and development teams.
  • Monitor project progress to ensure timely delivery of tasks and updates.
  • Proactively resolve issues, anticipate client needs, and address concerns promptly.
  • Regularly update clients on the status of their projects, keeping them informed and confident.
  • Coordinate with the internal team to ensure smooth workflow and task prioritization.
  • Use tools like Slack, Clickup, Microsoft Office & Google Sheets to manage communication, track progress, and organize tasks.
  • Occasionally make minor updates to client pages using low-code tools like Replo (training can be provided).
  • Ensure all communication is professional, timely, and aligned with the agency’s standards.

Required Skills & Experience:

  • Minimum of 2 years of experience in account management, client-facing roles, or project coordination (preferred, but flexible).
  • Proficiency in tools like Microsoft Office, Google Docs, Sheets, Slack, and Clickup (preferred).
  • Strong organizational skills and ability to multitask in a fast-paced environment.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with a professional tone.
  • Knowledge of low-code or no-code tools such as Replo, Webflow, or Framer is a plus.
  • A proactive approach to problem-solving and the ability to manage multiple clients and projects simultaneously.
  • High attention to detail and ability to ensure project deadlines are consistently met.

Success in This Role:

The success of this role will be determined by how well you can manage client communication, keep projects on track, and free up the agency owner from direct involvement in day-to-day project management. You will be successful if:

  • Clients feel valued, heard, and confident that their projects are progressing smoothly.
  • Projects are delivered on time without unnecessary delays.
  • You are very proactive and don’t let too much time go by without getting back to clients, and our dev/design team
  • You make sure the check in with clients daily while projects are active, stay on top of the accounts and projects eagerly
  • Projects are delivered on time without unnecessary delays.
  • Communication between clients and the internal team is clear, professional, and well-organized.
  • The agency owner is free to focus on sales and lead generation, thanks to your reliable handling of client accounts.
  • You demonstrate strong organizational skills and professionalism, keeping all stakeholders informed and aligned.

Compensation & Work Schedule:

  • Salary: Pays hourly (depending on experience).
  • Work schedule: Part-time, 25-30 hours per week.
  • Start date: As soon as possible. Preferably someone with minimal need for training, experienced in similar roles.
  • We will start with a 2-3 month trial period to see if we’re a good fit and go from there

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). A Dexian incentiva a DIVERSIDADE. Nossas oportunidades também estão disponíveis para candidatura de pessoas com deficiência e reabilitados.

Esta oportunidade é para atuar em uma multinacional do setor de eletrodomésticos e soluções para o lar. O profissional será responsável por análises financeiras (CAPEX e OPEX), gestão de portfólio e reporte de resultados, contribuindo para a tomada de decisão estratégica com foco em eficiência, redução de custos e melhoria contínua

title: Pessoa Executiva Comercial - Grandes Contas - Mercado Pago
description:
Descrição da Oportunidade

No Mercado Livre estamos democratizando o comércio e os serviços financeiros para transformar a vida das pessoas na América Latina. Faça parte deste propósito!

Nosso negócio Fintech oferece para toda a região uma proposta de valor integral, que visa democratizar os serviços financeiros e satisfazer as necessidades de mais de 60 milhões de usuários e usuárias.

Disponibilizamos uma plataforma online que permite receber pelas vendas eletrônicas realizadas, tanto dentro como fora do Mercado Livre, e um sistema de códigos QR e dispositivos Point para as vendas realizadas no mundo físico.

Para milhões de comerciantes, empreendedores e profissionais, damos a possibilidade de processar suas operações com segurança, através de mais de 50 meios de pagamento na América Latina.

Além disso, fornecemos acesso gratuito a uma conta digital que permite pagar, enviar e receber dinheiro, gerar renda e trabalhar com cartões para fazer compras ou saques.

Através do Mercado Crédito, concedemos créditos para satisfazer as necessidades daqueles a quem prestamos nossos serviços e potencializar os negócios de quem vende através da nossa plataforma.

Temos um desafio para as pessoas que:

  • Vibram energia empreendedora: são movidas pela curiosidade, nunca desistem e estão focadas em superar seus próprios limites.
  • Dão o máximo, porque adoram trabalhar com compromisso e dedicação.
  • Encaram as mudanças como oportunidades e aprendem com seus erros.
  • A excelência e a execução são primordiais na sua forma de fazer as coisas.
  • Promovem o bom clima, a alegria e a diversão.
  • Sabem como construir com outras pessoas e desfrutam trabalhando em equipe.

Imagine você empreendendo projetos desafiadores, dinâmicos e inovadores, e sendo responsável por:

  • Trazer novos clientes para o canal, com perfil Grandes Contas .
  • Atuar no funil inteiro de vendas, desde prospecção, qualificação e negociação.
  • Acompanhar e analisar relatórios de atividades, assim como a eficiência do canal considerando dois KPIS, Volume Total de Pagamentos e Receitas.
  • Garantir o desenvolvimento do canal, participando ativamente na estruturação da metodologia, processos e, até mesmo, produto. Trazendo inputs para áreas responsáveis, representando os clientes e acelerando as melhorias.
  • Acompanhamento e compartilhamento das ações das concorrências, através de potenciais clientes, mercado e entorno competitivo diretos e indiretos.

Requisitos:

  • Possuir formação superior completa e/ou cursando.
  • Experiência em canais de vendas com foco em aquisição e formação de carteira de clientes.
  • Desejável conhecimentos em Adquirência.

Nós lhe propomos:

  • Ser parte de uma empresa com espírito empreendedor, na qual adoramos pensar grande e em longo prazo.
  • Ser protagonista de seu desenvolvimento em um ambiente de oportunidades, aprendizagem, crescimento, expansão e projetos desafiadores.
  • Compartilhar e aprender em equipe, com excelentes profissionais e especialistas.
  • Um excelente clima de trabalho, com todo o necessário para você viver uma grande experiência. :)

O Mercado Livre não faz contato oferecendo oportunidades em troca de pagamento de dinheiro. Você tem acesso a todas as oportunidades abertas no nosso site de carreiras. Caso receba pedidos de dinheiro, desconfie!

description:

  • Integrate third-party APIs and services efficiently and securely.
  • Ensure security best practices (Devise, Pundit, JWT auth) are applied across the stack.
  • Monitor, debug, and profile production systems to maintain high performance.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement by identifying and applying best practices in Rails development.

  • Expertise in Ruby on Rails: deep knowledge of MVC, ActiveRecord, service objects, concerns, and RESTful architecture.
  • Strong experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL), query optimization, and indexing.
  • Proficiency with popular Rails gems such as:
  • Devise (authentication)
  • Pundit/CanCanCan (authorization)
  • Sidekiq (background jobs)
  • Searchkick/PGSearch (search capabilities)
  • RSpec & FactoryBot (testing)
  • ActiveStorage/CarrierWave/Shrine (file handling)
  • PaperTrail (auditing/versioning)
  • Experience with Git workflows and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Ability to troubleshoot, debug, and optimize complex Rails applications.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with attention to detail.

Nice to Have

  • Experience deploying and scaling apps on Heroku or AWS.
  • Familiarity with Docker or containerized Rails environments.
  • Exposure to frontend technologies (React, JavaScript) to collaborate effectively.
  • Knowledge of caching strategies (Redis, Memcached) for performance optimization.
